TimedTween.luau.description: A zero-to-one linear tween with a configurable transition time. Public entry points include `TimedTween.new`, `TimedTween.SetTransitionTime`, `TimedTween.GetTransitionTime`, `TimedTween.ObserveTransitionTime`, `TimedTween.ObserveRenderStepped`, `TimedTween.ObserveOnSignal`, `TimedTween.Observe`, `TimedTween.PromiseFinished`.
